title: Move every third-party connection into /sdlc-setup
acceptance_criteria: /sdlc-setup has a third-party connection step and a `connect` mode that runs on an already initialised project without re-initialising it.

skills/sdlc-setup/CONNECTIONS.md is the single procedure for connecting Stitch (MCP server, API key, stitch-skills), the Rive account and tracker CLIs: read-only discovery first, user consent for each machine change, interactive logins and secrets handled by the user outside chat and repository, verified/unverified/declined status per execution host.
Role profiles and references/DESIGN-TOOLS.md no longer instruct workers to log in, register MCP servers or install skills; a missing connection becomes a blocker that names /sdlc-setup connect.
sdlc.py doctor reports a missing tracker CLI, login or Jira connection with `/sdlc-setup connect` instead of a login command.
Bundled skill versions and core.json are 0.1.8; README documents the 0.1.7 -> 0.1.8 upgrade.
test_seams: Bundled skill files and text contracts, plus environment.tracker_checks with mocked CLI lookups; tests do not log in, install or call third-party services.

documentation.assessment: Process change: third-party connections are owned by /sdlc-setup. Update the setup skill, DESIGN-TOOLS reference, two role profiles and README. No config/task schema change; requirement IDs are not applicable. The core.json version bump is a protected path; the named approver (Nguyen Quang Hung) approved it on 2026-10-26, and scope still reports that path.

updates.change: Add the connection step and connect mode.
